name: ehsas-megowal
description: Village welfare fund manager for Ehsas Program, Megowal: member contributions, pending dues, aid case tracking (weddings, funerals, medical), cash accounts and transparent monthly reports. Built with Next.js, TypeScript and MongoDB.

paragraphs: A web app for the village welfare fund of Megowal. Members give a fixed monthly contribution; two heads keep the money and use it to help families in need (a daughter's wedding, a death in the family, medical treatment, school fees, house repair, ration). The app replaces the paper registers: every rupee in and out is recorded, every aid case is tracked from request to completion, each month is closed and locked, and members can see their own account and an anonymised monthly report on their phone.
Deploying? See DEPLOY.md for step-by-step Vercel instructions and the manual checklist.
features: Bilingual: English and Urdu (right-to-left, Nastaliq). Member screens open in Urdu, management screens in English; anyone can switch.
Phone first: built for heads using a phone in the village; installable as an app, with a read-only offline mode.
No paid services needed: MongoDB Atlas free tier, WhatsApp share links instead of a paid API; photo storage (Cloudflare R2) and email (Resend) are optional.
Home: amount still owed, which months of this year are paid, the latest receipt.
Full contribution history with every receipt (view and PDF in Urdu or English).

requirements.text: Security headers with a per-request Content Security Policy, login rate limiting (5 wrong passwords per 15 minutes) and limits on uploads, imports, emails and backups.
Open and log in with the admin mobile and password from .env.local.
